description: This Java source file defines the GenericDispatcherFactory class, which implements the LocalDispatcherFactory interface. It provides methods to create and manage dispatchers for services within the Apache OFBiz framework, including an inner class for the default dispatcher implementation with methods for synchronous and asynchronous service execution, enabling/disabling ECAS, and handling transaction contexts.

classes.name: GenericDispatcherFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating LocalDispatcher instances within the OFBiz framework.
